senses.gloss: ch. same; trnsf. to be clear, to understand.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:12">Kidd. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>לא צַהֲרִיתוּ</he> you do not understand (the law) clearly; cmp. <cite ref="H00444"><he>חֲוַר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 14b:3">Bets. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>דהוה קלופיה צְהִיר טפי</he> Ms. M. (ed., v. <cite ref="R00319"><he>צִיהֲרָא</he></cite>) the peeled surface of the grain was very bright (white,—an indication that it was pounded immediately before it was cooked).
